description:
Found by the fz-kdt.194 cold review and the fz-kdt.179 build (2026-09-03),
both present at base ca23b676f and unchanged by either ticket.

1. `fixtures2/behavior/enumerable_protocol_dispatch.fz` exits 1 when compiled
   through the AOT `build` door and run, on the base binary and under both
   tickets` prototypes. Its interp and JIT `run` doors are fine. The fixture is
   in the matrix`s ignored set for other reasons, so the matrix does not catch
   it; it was found only by an explicit three-door sweep.
2. `fixtures2/00421_reduce_cont_clause.fz` has no `main/0` and STALLS standalone
   `fz2 interp` rather than reporting that it has no entry point. It is
   measurable only through a test harness, which is why it went unnoticed as a
   canon mover in fz-kdt.179 (that ticket`s builder counted it as a 5th drop
   fixture; the reviewer`s corpus method reached only 4 because the fixture
   cannot be swept directly).

Both are three-door parity / diagnosability gaps rather than miscompiles.
CONCORDANT: fz-kdt.78 (require explicit asserted gate ownership for every
fixtures2 source -- a fixture that no gate drives and that cannot be swept is
exactly what that ticket is about); fz-kdt.149 (00424 panics at
artifact.rs:155, the same "a fixture fails on a door and nothing owns it"
family).

RED-FIRST: the AOT door of enumerable_protocol_dispatch exits 0 with the
expected stdout; `fz2 interp fixtures2/00421_reduce_cont_clause.fz` reports a
missing entry point instead of stalling.
title: [BUG] enumerable_protocol_dispatch exits 1 through AOT build, and 00421_reduce_cont_clause stalls standalone interp
